sentences.en: "For a week Doctor Jekyll was shut in his room, and I did not see him."

sentences.en: "I think that he needs it now," Poole said.

sentences.en: The servants stood in the hall, and they did not speak.

sentences.en: Poole took a light, and he and Utterson went up to the door of Jekyll's room.

sentences.en: "If that is so, I must go in," Utterson said.

sentences.en: "Once I saw a small man in the room, and he ran out," Poole said.

sentences.en: A fire was in the room, and on the table there were papers and a glass.

sentences.en: In a corner of the room there was a big glass, and Utterson looked in it and saw only the light and himself.

sentences.en: "We came too late to save him or to punish him," Utterson said.

sentences.en: Utterson took Lanyon's letter from his safe and opened it, and this is what Lanyon had written.

sentences.en: "On a night in January a letter came to me from Jekyll."

sentences.en: "I thought that Jekyll was sick in his mind, but I did as he asked."

sentences.en: "'Now, Lanyon, you must choose,' he said."

sentences.en: "'Do you want me to go, or do you want to see?'"

sentences.en: "He gave a cry, and he fell against the table, and he held it."

sentences.tgt: «:o En:o un:o instant:n ,:o ce:o ne:o fut:v plus:o le:o visage:n du:o petit:a homme:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Jekyll stood before me, and he was white, and he looked at me with fear."
sentences.tgt: «:o Jekyll:o se:o tenait:v devant:o moi:o ,:o blême:a ,:o et:o il:o me:o regardait:v avec:o effroi:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I cannot tell you what I felt, Utterson."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o saurais:v vous:o dire:v ce:o que:o je:o ressentis:v ,:o Utterson:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I saw Jekyll where I had seen the small man, and I will not forget it."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ai:v vu:v Jekyll:o là:a où:o j':o avais:v vu:v le:o petit:a homme:n ,:o et:o je:o ne:o l':o oublierai:v jamais:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "My mind is sick, and I will be dead soon."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o en:o ai:v l':o âme:n malade:a ,:o et:o je:o serai:v bientôt:a mort:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: Lanyon wrote, "Henry Jekyll has told you all the rest in his own paper."
sentences.tgt: Lanyon:o concluait:v ::o «:o Henry:o Jekyll:o vous:o a:v raconté:v tout:o le:o reste:n dans:o sa:o propre:a confession:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Utterson put down the letter, and he took up the paper of Jekyll.
sentences.tgt: Utterson:o posa:v la:o lettre:n et:o prit:v la:o confession:n de:o Jekyll:o .:o

sentences.en: Utterson took the paper of Jekyll, and this is what Jekyll had written.
sentences.tgt: Utterson:o déplia:v la:o confession:n de:o Jekyll:o ;:o voici:o ce:o que:o celui-ci:o avait:v écrit:v .:o

sentences.en: "I was born to a good name and a rich house, and I was a man of 50 years."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o naquis:v avec:o un:o nom:n respecté:a et:o une:o grande:a fortune:n ,:o et:o j':o ai:v aujourd'hui:a cinquante:o ans:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I wanted to be a good man, and I wanted all men to love me."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o voulais:v être:v un:o homme:n de:o bien:n ,:o et:o je:o voulais:v que:o tout:o le:o monde:n m':o aime:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "But I had bad wishes too, and I did not want any man to see them."
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o j':o avais:v aussi:a de:o mauvais:a penchants:n ,:o que:o je:o tenais:v à:o cacher:v aux:o yeux:n de:o tous:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I saw that a man is not one man but two."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o compris:v que:o l':o homme:n n':o est:v pas:o un:o ,:o mais:o deux:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I knew that it was true, because I felt it in me."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o savais:v que:o c':o était:v vrai:a ,:o car:o je:o le:o sentais:v en:o moi:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "If the good side and the bad side were in two bodies, the two men would be free."
sentences.tgt: «:o Si:o la:o part:n du:o bien:n et:o la:o part:n du:o mal:n habitaient:v deux:o corps:n ,:o chacun:o des:o deux:o hommes:n serait:v libre:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The good man could do good, and the bad man could do bad."
sentences.tgt: «:o L':o homme:n de:o bien:n pourrait:v faire:v le:o bien:n ,:o et:o le:o méchant:n faire:v le:o mal:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "For many years I was in my room, and I looked for a way to do it."
sentences.tgt: «:o Pendant:o de:o longues:a années:n ,:o je:o restai:v enfermé:a dans:o mon:o cabinet:n ,:o à:o chercher:v le:o moyen:n d':o y:o parvenir:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "At last I made a powder and put it in red water, and I drank it."
sentences.tgt: «:o Enfin:a ,:o je:o mis:v au:o point:n une:o poudre:n ,:o je:o la:o fis:v dissoudre:v dans:o de:o la:o teinture:n rouge:a ,:o et:o je:o bus:v le:o tout:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I felt great pain, and I was sick, and then the pain went."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ressentis:v une:o douleur:n atroce:a ,:o je:o fus:v pris:v de:o nausées:n ,:o puis:o la:o douleur:n se:o dissipa:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I felt young, and I felt light, and I was bad, and I was glad."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o me:o sentis:v jeune:a ,:o léger:a ,:o méchant:a ,:o et:o je:o m':o en:o réjouis:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I ran to the glass, and I saw a small man with a dark face."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o courus:v au:o miroir:n ,:o et:o j':o y:o vis:v un:o petit:a homme:n au:o visage:n sombre:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "It was Hyde, and he was bad to see, but I was glad to see him."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o était:v Hyde:o ;:o il:o faisait:v peur:n à:o voir:v ,:o et:o pourtant:a sa:o vue:n me:o réjouit:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I was not afraid of him, because he was my own."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o ne:o m':o effrayait:v pas:o ,:o car:o il:o était:v une:o part:n de:o moi-même:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "He was small, because the bad side of me was smaller than the good side."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o était:v petit:a ,:o car:o la:o part:n du:o mal:n ,:o en:o moi:o ,:o était:v moins:a grande:a que:o celle:o du:o bien:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I drank again, and I was Jekyll again."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o bus:v de:o nouveau:a ,:o et:o je:o redevins:v Jekyll:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I took a house in Soho for Hyde, and I gave him a servant."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o louai:v pour:o Hyde:o une:o maison:n à:o Soho:o ,:o et:o je:o lui:o donnai:v une:o domestique:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I made a will, and it said that Hyde would have all that I had if Jekyll died."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o rédigeai:v un:o testament:n stipulant:v que:o ,:o si:o Jekyll:o mourait:v ,:o tout:o ce:o que:o je:o possédais:v reviendrait:v à:o Hyde:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I could be Hyde when I wanted, and no man could say that Hyde was Jekyll."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o pouvais:v devenir:v Hyde:o à:o volonté:n ,:o et:o nul:o n':o aurait:v pu:v dire:v que:o Hyde:o et:o Jekyll:o ne:o faisaient:v qu':o un:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Hyde did the bad things that I wanted to do, and Jekyll did not."
sentences.tgt: «:o Hyde:o faisait:v le:o mal:n dont:o j':o avais:v envie:n ,:o et:o Jekyll:o ,:o lui:o ,:o gardait:v les:o mains:n propres:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I liked to be Hyde, because Hyde was free."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o aimais:v être:v Hyde:o ,:o car:o Hyde:o était:v libre:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "As Hyde I felt young and light, and I did not care what men said."
sentences.tgt: «:o Sous:o les:o traits:n de:o Hyde:o ,:o je:o me:o sentais:v jeune:a et:o léger:a ,:o et:o je:o me:o moquais:v bien:a de:o ce:o que:o les:o gens:n pouvaient:v dire:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "When I was tired of Hyde, I drank and was Jekyll, and no man could say that I had done a bad thing."
sentences.tgt: «:o Quand:o j':o étais:v las:a d':o être:v Hyde:o ,:o je:o buvais:v et:o redevenais:v Jekyll:o ,:o et:o nul:o n':o aurait:v pu:v me:o reprocher:v la:o moindre:a faute:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I did not stop, and I did not want to stop."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o m':o arrêtai:v pas:o ,:o et:o je:o ne:o voulais:v pas:o m':o arrêter:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Hyde did bad things, and he was not sorry for them."
sentences.tgt: «:o Hyde:o faisait:v le:o mal:n ,:o et:o il:o n':o en:o éprouvait:v aucun:o remords:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Every day he grew stronger, and I was afraid of him."
sentences.tgt: «:o Chaque:o jour:n ,:o il:o devenait:v plus:a fort:a ,:o et:o il:o me:o faisait:v peur:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Once Hyde walked over a girl in the street, and men stopped him, and I paid them from my own bank."
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o jour:n ,:o Hyde:o passa:v sur:o le:o corps:n d':o une:o fillette:n dans:o la:o rue:n ;:o des:o passants:n l':o arrêtèrent:v ,:o et:o je:o les:o payai:v avec:o un:o chèque:n tiré:a sur:o mon:o propre:a compte:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "After that I made a bank for Hyde."
sentences.tgt: «:o Après:o cela:o ,:o j':o ouvris:v un:o compte:n au:o nom:n de:o Hyde:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I wrote his name in a new hand, so that no man could say that it was mine."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o signai:v de:o son:o nom:n d':o une:o écriture:n nouvelle:a ,:o afin:o que:o nul:o ne:o pût:v la:o reconnaître:v pour:o la:o mienne:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "One morning I woke in my own bed, and I looked at my hand."
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o matin:n ,:o je:o m':o éveillai:v dans:o mon:o propre:a lit:n ,:o et:o je:o regardai:v ma:o main:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "It was small and dark, and it was the hand of Hyde."
sentences.tgt: «:o Elle:o était:v petite:a et:o sombre:a ::o c':o était:v la:o main:n de:o Hyde:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I had gone to sleep as Jekyll, and now I was Hyde."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o m':o étais:v endormi:v sous:o les:o traits:n de:o Jekyll:o ,:o et:o je:o me:o réveillais:v sous:o ceux:o de:o Hyde:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I was afraid, because the drink was in my room, and I had to go through the house to get it."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o eus:v peur:n ,:o car:o le:o breuvage:n se:o trouvait:v dans:o mon:o cabinet:n ,:o et:o il:o me:o fallait:v traverser:v toute:o la:o maison:n pour:o l':o atteindre:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I hid my face and went through the house, and the servants looked at me."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o traversai:v la:o maison:n en:o cachant:v mon:o visage:n ,:o sous:o le:o regard:n des:o domestiques:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I drank, and in an hour I was Jekyll again."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o bus:v ,:o et:o une:o heure:n plus:a tard:a j':o étais:v redevenu:v Jekyll:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I saw that Hyde could take me when he wanted."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o compris:v que:o Hyde:o pouvait:v s':o emparer:v de:o moi:o quand:o il:o le:o voulait:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I said that I would give up Hyde, and for 2 months I was Jekyll, and I was good."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o résolus:v de:o renoncer:v à:o Hyde:o ,:o et:o pendant:o deux:o mois:n ,:o je:o restai:v Jekyll:o et:o me:o conduisis:v en:o homme:n de:o bien:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "But I did not like to be only Jekyll, and I wanted to be free."
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o il:o me:o pesait:v de:o n':o être:v que:o Jekyll:o ,:o et:o je:o brûlais:v d':o être:v libre:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "At last I wanted to be Hyde again, and I drank."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o finis:v par:o céder:v à:o l':o envie:n de:o redevenir:v Hyde:o ,:o et:o je:o bus:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "That night Hyde was worse than before."
sentences.tgt: «:o Cette:o nuit-là:n ,:o Hyde:o fut:v pire:a que:o jamais:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "A kind old man spoke to him in the street, and Hyde hit him with a cane until he was dead."
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o vieux:a monsieur:n à:o l':o air:n bienveillant:a lui:o adressa:v la:o parole:n dans:o la:o rue:n ,:o et:o Hyde:o le:o frappa:v de:o sa:o canne:n jusqu':o à:o ce:o que:o mort:n s':o ensuive:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Hyde was glad with every hit, and I did not stop him."
sentences.tgt: «:o Hyde:o se:o délectait:v de:o chaque:o coup:n ,:o et:o je:o ne:o fis:v rien:o pour:o l':o arrêter:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "When it was done, I was afraid, and I ran to Soho, and I burned my papers."
sentences.tgt: «:o Quand:o ce:o fut:v fini:a ,:o la:o peur:n me:o prit:v ;:o je:o courus:v à:o Soho:o et:o je:o brûlai:v mes:o papiers:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I drank, and I was Jekyll again, and I wept, and I said that I would never be Hyde again."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o bus:v ,:o je:o redevins:v Jekyll:o ,:o je:o pleurai:v ,:o et:o je:o jurai:v de:o ne:o plus:o jamais:o redevenir:v Hyde:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "That night I sat in my room, and I saw the face of the old man again and again."
sentences.tgt: «:o Cette:o nuit-là:n ,:o assis:a dans:o mon:o cabinet:n ,:o je:o revoyais:v sans:o cesse:n le:o visage:n du:o vieux:a monsieur:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "For 2 months I was a good man, and I helped many poor men."
sentences.tgt: «:o Pendant:o deux:o mois:n ,:o je:o fus:v un:o homme:n de:o bien:n ,:o et:o je:o secourus:v bien:a des:o pauvres:a gens:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "But Hyde was still in me, and he wanted to come out."
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o Hyde:o était:v toujours:a en:o moi:o ,:o et:o il:o ne:o demandait:v qu':o à:o sortir:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "One day I sat in a park in the sun, and I thought that I was a good man."
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o jour:n que:o j':o étais:v assis:a au:o soleil:n dans:o un:o jardin:n public:a ,:o je:o me:o disais:v que:o j':o étais:v un:o homme:n de:o bien:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I felt sick and cold, and I looked at my hand, and it was the hand of Hyde."
sentences.tgt: «:o Soudain:a ,:o je:o me:o sentis:v mal:a ,:o glacé:a ,:o et:o en:o regardant:v ma:o main:n ,:o je:o vis:v que:o c':o était:v celle:o de:o Hyde:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I was Hyde, and all the police in England wanted to find me."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o étais:v Hyde:o ,:o et:o toute:o la:o police:n d':o Angleterre:o était:v à:o mes:o trousses:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I had no drink, and my room was far away."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o n':o avais:v pas:o le:o breuvage:n sur:o moi:o ,:o et:o mon:o cabinet:n était:v loin:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I took a coach to an inn, and I wrote a letter to Lanyon, and I wrote to Poole too."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o pris:v un:o fiacre:n jusqu':o à:o une:o auberge:n ,:o d':o où:o j':o écrivis:v une:o lettre:n à:o Lanyon:o ,:o et:o une:o autre:o à:o Poole:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I did not dare to go out until it was night."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o n':o osai:v pas:o sortir:v avant:o la:o nuit:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "That night I walked in the streets, and men ran from me, and I was afraid."
sentences.tgt: «:o Cette:o nuit-là:n ,:o j':o errai:v dans:o les:o rues:n ;:o les:o passants:n me:o fuyaient:v ,:o et:o j':o avais:v peur:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "When Lanyon gave me the drawer, I drank in his room, and he saw me change."
sentences.tgt: «:o Quand:o Lanyon:o m':o eut:v remis:v le:o tiroir:n ,:o je:o bus:v dans:o son:o cabinet:n ,:o et:o il:o me:o vit:v changer:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I went home to my room, and I did not sleep."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o rentrai:v chez:o moi:o ,:o dans:o mon:o cabinet:n ,:o et:o je:o ne:o fermai:v pas:o l':o œil:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "In the morning I was Hyde again, and I had to drink to be Jekyll."
sentences.tgt: «:o Au:o matin:n ,:o j':o étais:v de:o nouveau:a Hyde:o ,:o et:o il:o me:o fallut:v boire:v pour:o redevenir:v Jekyll:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Every day it was harder to be Jekyll, and every day Hyde came without the drink."
sentences.tgt: «:o De:o jour:n en:o jour:n ,:o il:o m':o était:v plus:a dur:a de:o rester:v Jekyll:o ,:o et:o chaque:o jour:n ,:o Hyde:o revenait:v sans:o l':o aide:n du:o breuvage:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "One day I sat at my window, and Utterson and Enfield spoke to me from below."
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o jour:n que:o j':o étais:v assis:a à:o ma:o fenêtre:n ,:o Utterson:o et:o Enfield:o me:o parlèrent:v d':o en:o bas:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I began to change while I spoke to them, and I shut the window and went in."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o commençai:v à:o changer:v tandis:o que:o je:o leur:o parlais:v ,:o et:o je:o refermai:v la:o fenêtre:n pour:o me:o retirer:v à:o l':o intérieur:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "The powder began to run out, and I sent Poole to get more."
sentences.tgt: «:o La:o poudre:n commença:v à:o manquer:v ,:o et:o j':o envoyai:v Poole:o en:o chercher:v d':o autre:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I drank the new powder, and nothing happened."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o bus:v la:o nouvelle:a poudre:n ,:o et:o il:o ne:o se:o passa:v rien:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I saw that the first powder had something in it that I did not know, and now I could not make it again."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o compris:v que:o la:o première:a poudre:n contenait:v quelque:o chose:n dont:o j':o ignorais:v tout:o ,:o et:o que:o désormais:a je:o ne:o pourrais:v plus:o la:o refaire:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I write this in my room with the last of my powder."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o écris:v ces:o lignes:n dans:o mon:o cabinet:n ,:o grâce:n à:o la:o dernière:a pincée:n de:o ma:o poudre:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "If I change while I write, Hyde will burn this paper."
sentences.tgt: «:o Si:o la:o métamorphose:n me:o surprend:v pendant:o que:o j':o écris:v ,:o Hyde:o brûlera:v ces:o pages:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Hyde will be afraid of the police, and he will die by his own hand, or the judges will kill him."
sentences.tgt: «:o Hyde:o aura:v peur:n de:o la:o police:n ,:o et:o il:o se:o donnera:v la:o mort:n ,:o à:o moins:a que:o les:o juges:n ne:o l':o envoient:v à:o la:o potence:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I do not know how long I will be Jekyll, and I write fast."
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ignore:v combien:a de:o temps:n je:o resterai:v encore:a Jekyll:o ,:o et:o j':o écris:v en:o hâte:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Here I end the life of Henry Jekyll."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ici:a ,:o je:o mets:v fin:n à:o la:o vie:n de:o Henry:o Jekyll:o .:o »:o
